_about: Theme schema template. Copy this file to themes/<your-name>/{light,dark}/theme.json and edit. Every key is documented inline via _comment_* keys (ignored at runtime). All keys here are required unless marked optional. Colors are RGBA arrays in the 0..1 range. Sizes ending in 'sp' scale with system font density; numbers in `layout` are dp.
name: Display name shown in Settings spinner (e.g. 'Clean Light')
_comment_font: Font face must be registered via LabelBase.register in main.py. Drop your .ttf into assets/fonts/.
_comment_font_sizes: Seven canonical roles — referenced from KV via size_role: 'medium'. Pick a coherent scale; current panel is 1024x600 native.
_comment_colors: Named color roles — referenced from KV via color_role: 'font_highlight'. font_* are text colors; active/inactive/warning/error are semantic; trend/weekend/weekday/bar_* are domain-specific.

colors._comment_shadow: Shadow color flips based on app.theme_mode. shadow_light is used in light mode (dark shadow on bright bg); shadow_dark is used in dark mode (light halo on dark bg).

_comment_layout: Single source of truth for spacing/sizing. grid_unit = 8 dp; everything else is a multiple of it. padding_*/spacing_* are sm=8, md=16, lg=24, xl=32. widget_height_* are sm=32, md=48, lg=64. menu_* / content_padding / widget_spacing are kept for legacy <ThemedButton> and screen rules.
_comment_overlays: Per-screen overlay PNG. Set to '' (empty string) to disable per-screen overlays — the screen still renders, just without a decoration layer.
_comment_background: App-wide background. PNG should match 1024x600. If the file doesn't exist, app renders a solid color from panel_bg fallback.
_comment_menu: Top-bar menu styling. menu_button_normal/_active are 9-patch PNGs. menu_button_size is [width, height] in dp.
_comment_button: ThemedButton background — set to '' for plain Kivy default look.
